description: Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 validation: the CEN EN16931 and Peppol Schematron rule sets, compiled to XSLT 2.0 by SchXslt 1.10.1 (testdata/bench/peppol/xsl), each applied to every example invoice; the output is SVRL. Normalise is whitespace (indentation and Saxon's attribute wrapping differ), after strip removes what differs by design: the run timestamp (dct:created, current-dateTime; the compile-time one is a constant and goes too), the processor's own name and version (skos:prefLabel), and the file: URI spelling of the source document (file:/ in Saxon, file:/// in go-xml). xsltproc is omitted: the stylesheets are XSLT 2.0.
